message:
docs(field): 15:09-15:17 follow-up run with viewer logs -- NACK negotiated (no loss), 57/57 gap IDRs resynced without requests, backend-switch stamp lag trips congestion twice

The office client re-logged in at 15:09:56, so viewer.log/client.log upload again (a login
side effect, not a P10 fix; the host uploader is still on 401). This session ran P2P
(directory chose the public candidate, relay never bound); control RTT med 2.0 ms.

- typing 5.8 fps / video ~50.5 fps decoded (host udpTxFrames 1,695 per 30 s, 33 Mbps) /
  present gap med 16 ms in video; viewer decode ~5 ms, decode->present 5-9 ms.
- nackNegotiated=1 on the wire, but 310k chunks with zero loss: retransmit effect unproven.
- every seq gap (57) was closed by the complete IDR itself: keyResync=57, keyReq=0, no
  reason-2 request in the session (09-05 had 90/90).
- UAC: two decode_queue congestion entries (lag 567/848 ms) resolved by one IDR each; the
  host's first frame after each backend switch carries a capture stamp 126/820 ms older than
  its send stamp -- a stamp lag on real frames, not the synthetic case. New plan item P11.
- UAC click coordinates: the secure-input agent logs only its first 12 button events per
  process (spent at 14:27), so the 15:15 clicks are unrecorded; P9 stays open.
